accepted.sentence: In salsa arrangements, it often contributes repeated rhythmic figures and short answering phrases beneath or between vocal lines.
Church services may feature it in a small brass ensemble that supports hymn singing or ceremonial processions.
A piano accompanist can support its solo recital repertoire, allowing a player to perform outside a larger ensemble.
Symphony seating usually groups it with the brass behind the woodwinds, although the exact layout depends on the hall and score.
Rock bands with horn sections may use it in punchy ensemble riffs between vocal lines.
For a film score, players may record separate parts in multiple takes to build a larger-sounding section.
Some chamber works pair it with an organ, whose sustained tones complement its changing melodic lines.
At community concerts, it may perform familiar melodies in an informal brass ensemble alongside other local musicians.
